brief: 5 Free Tools every creator uses to ship daily content.

slots.title: Notion Workspace
slots.body: Map your content calendar, store ideas, and track every post in one flexible database that syncs across devices.

slots.title: ChatGPT Drafts
slots.body: Beat writer's block by turning rough bullets into polished captions, hooks, and thread ideas in seconds.

slots.title: Canva Designs
slots.body: Build thumb-stopping carousels, stories, and banners with drag-and-drop templates sized for every platform.

slots.title: CapCut Edits
slots.body: Trim clips, add captions, and drop trending audio without paying for pro video editing software.

slots.title: Buffer Queue
slots.body: Schedule a week of posts across platforms in one sitting so you never miss a daily shipping streak.

slots.title: Daily Workflow
slots.body: Link these five tools into a morning routine: plan in Notion, draft in ChatGPT, design in Canva, edit in CapCut, then schedule in Buffer.
Pick one tool, build a 7-day calendar, and post your first piece before midnight. Consistency wins.
